page: Amazon Web Services c9gd.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor and powered by custom AWS Graviton processors. The instance provides 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs built on 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64), operating at a frequency of 3.3 GHz. With one hardware thread per core, the system avoids resource contention commonly associated with simultaneous multithreading, ensuring predictable execution cycles for each processor core.

Memory configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per-core allocation that aligns with standard compute-intensive provisioning ratios. In addition to general compute resources, this instance bundles 1900 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD instance storage, enabling high-throughput local disk I/O. Network connectivity features a baseline throughput of 17 Gbps, while no discrete GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned.

From an architectural standpoint, utilizing 64-bit ARM requires binaries and software stacks to support the aarch64 instruction set rather than x86_64. The paired 1:2 memory ratio and 1900 GB local NVMe drive establish balanced efficiency for compute-heavy workloads requiring fast ephemeral storage. Typical suitable workloads include CI/CD compilation and build farms, batch processing, video transcoding, distributed data analytics, and high-throughput caching tiers.
